title: Assistive Overlay
description: Enhance visual UI elements for accessibility. Look quick and understand fast!
body:
![Assistive Overlay](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/da4ab2eb53d21f90490eae9f7c684b73f2c7833f.png)A mod & resource Pack collection that aims for quick visual information gathering. May aid Low vision, dyslexia or those with eye strain. Useful for those who need assistance in need of identifying blocks and text based information it includes and or produces. Aims to add to base game UI.
<details>
<summary>Note</summary>

**Not an optimization pack as the goal of this modpack is visual aid.** *Add your own tweaks*


</details>


### _**Features**_
- **Redstone** - Understand the numeric ticks and signals they give.
- **Searching** - See what items go in what creative mode tab.
- **Ping**- Read your ping and others! 
- **Better Chat** - Smoother,longer,faster,bigger history,time stamps and no report features included!
- **Enchantments and Potions** - Outlines for tools and different potions shapes.
